formulaTitle|Understand the calculation|了解计算方法

formulaText|Labelled units = volume × labelled share. Additional revenue = base price × premium × labelled units. Extra costs = extra unit cost × labelled units + fixed costs. Incremental balance = additional revenue − extra costs. Break-even premium = extra costs ÷ (base price × labelled units). With no labelled units, break-even cannot be calculated. This balance is neither total profit nor national-accounts value added.|标志产品数量 = 总销量 × 使用标志的比例。新增收入 = 基准价格 × 溢价率 × 标志产品数量。新增成本 = 单位新增成本 × 标志产品数量 + 固定成本。净增收益 = 新增收入 − 新增成本。盈亏平衡溢价率 = 新增成本 ÷（基准价格 × 标志产品数量）。标志产品数量为零时，无法计算平衡点。此结果并非总利润，也非国民经济核算中的增加值。

coverageTitle|What is covered|覆盖范围

coverageText|137 Brazilian IPs in the 29 September 2026 list and 35 Brazilian DOs in the 20 October 2026 list: 172 registrations. The initial filter excludes one service registration. Foreign origins and recognition through agreements are excluded. A multi-state GI counts once nationally and once in each covered state, so state totals may exceed the national total.|2026年9月29日名录含137项巴西来源标志（IP），2026年10月20日名录含35项巴西原产地名称（DO），合计172项注册。默认筛选排除一项服务注册。不含外国原产地及通过协议认可的项目。跨州地理标志在全国总数中计一次，在各覆盖州分别计一次，因此各州总和可能超过全国总数。
recordsMethodTitle|Products, territories and dates|产品、产地与日期

recordsMethodText|Unit of analysis: INPI registration number. Repeated names may refer to different products or recognition types. Product families are an editorial classification. Search includes the territory description, without assuming every mentioned municipality is wholly inside a GI. IP-to-DO conversions retain the first date; details preserve official wording. State geometry: simplified IBGE boundaries, not GI polygons.|分析单位为 INPI 注册号。重复名称可能对应不同产品或认定类型。产品类别为编辑分类。搜索涵盖地域描述，但不假定被提及的城市全部属于该地理标志。IP 转为 DO 时保留首次注册日期，详情保留官方措辞。州界采用简化的 IBGE 地理数据，不是地理标志边界。
insightsMethodTitle|How insights are calculated|洞察的计算方法

insightsMethodText|Leading product family: share of the largest family in the selection. Concentration: unique registrations covered by the three leading states, with no double counting in the percentage. Recent registrations: first date within the five years ending in the selected year. IP/DO mix: type in the current lists. State ranking: one count per covered state. These describe formal recognition, not economic performance.|主要产品类别：当前筛选中注册最多的类别所占比例。集中度：排名前三州覆盖的不重复注册数，其百分比不重复计数。近期注册：首次注册日期在截至所选年份的五年内。IP/DO 构成：采用当前名录中的类型。州排名：每项注册在覆盖州各计一次。以上描述正式认定情况，不衡量经济绩效。
valueMethodTitle|How to interpret price gains|如何解读价格提升

valueMethodText|Exploratory curation of four cases, not an exhaustive systematic review. Price differentials, cumulative increases and expectations are distinct measures from different periods. Do not average or extrapolate them. Missing samples and controls remain limitations; figures are not inflation-adjusted. The conflicting socol registration date in Sebrae material is flagged; the INPI date takes precedence.|选取四个案例进行探索性整理，并非穷尽性的系统综述。价格差异、累计涨幅和预期来自不同时期，含义也不同，不应求平均或外推。缺少样本与对照仍是证据局限；数值未经通胀调整。Sebrae 资料中 socol 注册日期的矛盾已标注，以 INPI 日期为准。
